explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem shows that one of the library's own propositions, `ContinuousExtensionConvexMollificationOnInteriorClosedBallTheorem n`, implies another of its own propositions, `SmoothConvexApproximationOnInteriorClosedBallTheorem n`. Its content rests on these library-specific statements and on the library's own extension lemma. The only Mathlib facts the proof uses are generic glue: `ConvexOn.subset`, `Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall` and `convex_closedBall`. None of these carries the theorem's content. Mathlib has no statement about these library definitions, so I did not need to search further.
